item.title: Iranian Navy identifies oil tanker that caught fire in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Iranian Navy says it has identified a non-compliant oil tanker that sustained damage and caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz after switching off its tracking systems and attempting to cross a prohibited area.

item.title: Iran, Pakistan explore ways to expand mining cooperation
